# export: `ExportOutput`

The `data` payload of `openreadout export FILE --json`, inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `export`: an image export report (OME-TIFF, OME-Zarr), a CSV report for tables or
traces, or an mzML report for mass spectra.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/export.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/export.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema export`.

## Fields

Type: [`ExportReport`](#exportreport) | [`TableExportReport`](#tableexportreport) | [`TraceExportReport`](#traceexportreport) | [`MzmlExportReport`](#mzmlexportreport) | [`AsmExportReport`](#asmexportreport) | [`ColumnarExportReport`](#columnarexportreport) | [`NwbExportReport`](#nwbexportreport) | [`JcampExportReport`](#jcampexportreport) | [`RdmlExportReport`](#rdmlexportreport) | [`PerImageExport`](#perimageexport).

## Types

### ExportReport

What `export` reports.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `string` | yes | The file that was read. |
| `output` | `string` | yes | The OME-TIFF (or OME-Zarr) written. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | `ome-tiff` or `ome-zarr`. |
| `images_written` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Images written. |
| `planes_written` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Planes written, over all images. |
| `bytes_written` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Size of the output in bytes. |
| `verified` | `boolean` | yes | True when every written plane was read back and hashed equal to the source plane. |
| `codec` | [`Codec`](#codec) | yes | Compression used. |
| `ome_xml_bytes` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Size of the embedded OME-XML in bytes. |
| `resolutions` | array of [`WrittenLevels`](#writtenlevels) |  | Per image, the resolution levels written (tiled exports: pyramids, regions, levels); absent for single-resolution exports of whole planes. |
| `layout` | `string` or `null` |  | OME-Zarr: `plate` when the store is an OME-NGFF high-content screening plate (row, column and field groups); absent for single images and collections. |
| `images_skipped` | array of `integer` (uint32) |  | Images left out because plane files they need are missing (`--skip-incomplete`). |

### Codec

Compression codec for the TIFF strips.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"none"` | No compression. |
| `"deflate"` | Deflate (zlib), lossless; the default. |
| `"lzw"` | LZW, lossless; readable by older TIFF software. |

### WrittenLevels

Resolution levels written for one image by a tiled export.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Source image index. |
| `source_level` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Source pyramid level the exported full resolution was read from. |
| `region` | [`Region`](#region) or `null` |  | Rectangle of that level that was exported (absent: all of it). |
| `pyramid` | [`PyramidMode`](#pyramidmode) | yes | Where the lower levels came from: `source` (copied), `mean` (2 x 2 means) or `none`. |
| `sizes` | array of array of 2 × `integer` (uint32) | yes | `[width, height]` of every level written, full resolution first. |
| `factors` | array of `number` (double) | yes | Downsampling factor of every level relative to the exported full resolution (x). |

### Region

A rectangle of a plane, in the pixel coordinates of the resolution level it is read at.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Left edge (column of the first pixel). |
| `y` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Top edge (row of the first pixel). |
| `width` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Width in pixels (at least 1). |
| `height` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Height in pixels (at least 1). |

### PyramidMode

Where the lower resolutions of an export come from.

| value | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `"auto"` | The writer's default: the source's own levels when it has them and the whole image is exported from level 0; else 2 × 2 mean levels for OME-Zarr and none for OME-TIFF. |
| `"none"` | Full resolution only. |
| `"source"` | The source's own pyramid levels, copied. |
| `"mean"` | 2 × 2 mean levels computed from the exported resolution. |

### JcampExportReport

Output of `export --to jcamp`.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | `string` | yes | The input file. |
| `output` | `string` | yes | The JCAMP-DX file written. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Always `jcamp-dx`. |
| `jcamp_version` | `string` | yes | `##JCAMP-DX=` version written (`5.01`). |
| `data_type` | `string` | yes | `##DATA TYPE=` written (`NMR FID`, `NMR SPECTRUM`, or the source's data type). |

| `sweeps` | array of `integer` (uint32) | yes | Sweeps written. |
| `pages` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Data tables (NTUPLES pages; 1 for XYDATA). |
| `first_sample` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | First sample of each sweep written (zero-based). |
| `samples_written` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Points per sweep written. |
| `channels_written` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Channels written (one table per channel and sweep). |
| `encoding` | `string` | yes | `difdup` or `affn`. |
| `factors` | array of `number` (double) | yes | The ordinate factor of each channel (value = integer × factor). |
| `exact` | `boolean` | yes | True when every value round-trips bit-exactly. |
| `max_abs_error` | `number` (double) | yes | Largest |written − source| over all values (0 when `exact`; at most half the factor). |
| `bytes_written` | `integer` (uint64) | yes | Size of the written file in bytes. |
| `verified` | `boolean` | yes | True when the file was re-read and every ordinate matched. |
